title: Rav Acha bar Natan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Chullin 49a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.49a.7) according to Dikdukei Soferim, disagreeing with Mar Zutra son of Rav Mari; the text Hyman uses reads Rav Ada bar Natan. Hyman identifies Rav Mesharshiya as his son’s son.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Chullin gives Rav Ada bar Natan and Mar Zutra son of Rav Mari as the two disputants. Hyman reports the Acha reading from Dikdukei Soferim. The grandson identification is his.
